tr.title: Fotoğraf laboratuvarı

descriptions.ascii: Her küçük alanın parlaklığı, onu temsil eden karakteri seçer.
descriptions.dither: Siyah ve beyaz noktaların düzeni, gri tonları varmış gibi görünür.
descriptions.newsprint: Baskıdaki gibi: değişen büyüklükte noktalar, fotoğrafın tonlarını kurar.
descriptions.particles: Fotoğraf renkli noktalara ayrılır. Üzerinde gezinin; dağılan noktalar yerlerine döner.

en.title: Photo Lab

descriptions.original: Every experiment starts with this frame.
descriptions.ascii: Each small region becomes a character chosen from its brightness.
descriptions.dither: The arrangement of black and white dots creates the impression of gray.
descriptions.newsprint: Like a printed photograph: dots of different sizes build the tones.
descriptions.particles: The photograph becomes colored points. Move through them; they scatter and return home.

en.unavailable: This browser can’t display these effects. You can still view the original photograph.
en.imageError: The photograph couldn’t load. Try another frame.
en.depth: Brightness determines the depth of each particle.

ja.title: 写真ラボ

descriptions.original: すべての実験は、この一枚から始まります。
descriptions.ascii: 小さな領域ごとに、明るさに応じた文字を選びます。
descriptions.dither: 白と黒の点の配置が、灰色の濃淡を生み出します。
descriptions.newsprint: 印刷された写真のように、大きさの異なる点で濃淡を表します。
descriptions.particles: 写真が色のついた粒子に変わります。触れると散らばり、元の場所に戻ります。
